hub.speaker: Yvlon
hub.text: Stay behind my shield arm if it goes bad. Left side. My left. I've dug graves for people who got that wrong.

text_variants.text: Dust this thick means nothing's walked here in years, or whatever does walk here leaves no tracks. Walk behind me until we know which.
Solid work back there. You'd pass for a second-string Silver-rank. Now help me with this strap. Something cut it halfway through.
